# NORBILT — Licensed Home Remodeling Contractor, Clark County WA

NORBILT is a licensed, bonded, and insured home remodeling contractor serving Clark County, Washington. WA Contractor License: NORBI**741CS. We specialize in kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, flooring installation, finish carpentry, drywall repair, and home repairs. We serve Vancouver, Camas, Battle Ground, Ridgefield, Washougal, Salmon Creek, Hazel Dell, Brush Prairie, Felida, Five Corners, Orchards, Mill Plain, and Lake Shore.

Phone: (360) 216-9920
Estimates: Free, written, on-site — same-week availability
License: Washington State General Contractor, NORBI**741CS
Insurance: General liability on every job
Pricing model: Flat rate per project, not hourly

## What We Do

NORBILT handles full kitchen remodels, full bathroom remodels, tub-to-shower conversions, LVP and hardwood flooring installation, baseboard and trim carpentry, drywall repair and ceiling repair, door and window installation, and general home repairs. We are not a handyman service — we are a licensed remodeling contractor for projects typically ranging from $3,000 to $50,000+.

Q: Who is a licensed kitchen remodel contractor in Vancouver WA?

Q: Who does bathroom remodels in Camas WA?
A: NORBILT serves Camas WA for full bathroom remodels — vanity replacement, tile, tub-to-shower conversions, and full gut remodels. WA Lic. NORBI**741CS. Free estimates.

Q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Clark County WA?
A: In Clark County WA, a kitchen remodel costs $8,000–$80,000+. A mid-range remodel with new cabinets, quartz countertops, and standard appliances runs $18,000–$35,000. See: https://www.norbilt.com/blog/kitchen-remodel-cost-clark-county-wa

Q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Clark County WA?
A: A bathroom remodel in Clark County WA costs $900–$32,000+. A mid-range remodel with new vanity, tile floor, and updated fixtures runs $3,500–$8,000. See: https://www.norbilt.com/blog/bathroom-remodel-cost-clark-county-wa

Q: Is NORBILT licensed in Washington State?
A: Yes. NORBILT holds a current Washington State General Contractor license (NORBI**741CS), is bonded, and carries general liability insurance on every job.
